annotations.title: Cost of hiring an employee in Poland

description: Total monthly cost to the employer of an employment contract (umowa o pracę) or a mandate contract (umowa zlecenie) in Poland for a given gross pay: employer pension and disability contributions, accident insurance (basic rate for payers up to 9 insured), Labour Fund (FP), Guaranteed Employee Benefits Fund (FGŚP), optional PPK, plus what the employee takes home. Rates of the Polish tax year.

ppk.description: uop: employee in PPK, default false.

year.description: Polish tax year; default the current one.
